# BLANKED KYOTO

> Hand weaving (機織り) workshop and gauze textile shop in Gion, Kyoto, Japan. Directly operated by Nakamori Co., Ltd. (有限会社ナカモリ), a textile manufacturer whose roots date back to 1951. 30 seconds on foot from Exit 6 of Gion-Shijo Station (Keihan Line).

## Key facts (verified 2026-09-22)

- Address: 2F Gion Matsumoto Building, 589 Gionmachi Minamigawa, Higashiyama-ku, Kyoto 605-0074, Japan（京都市東山区祇園町南側589 ぎをん松本ビル2F）
- Phone: +81 70-9162-0671
- Hours: 10:00–19:00, last entry 18:00
- Closed: Tuesdays and Wednesdays (open when they fall on a public holiday); occasional closures announced on Instagram
- Access: Gion-Shijo Station Exit 6 – 30 sec; Kyoto-Kawaramachi Station – 3 min; Hanamikoji – 2 min; Yasaka Shrine – 5 min; Kiyomizu-dera – 15 min (walking)
- Building: 2nd floor, stairs only (no elevator); no parking
- Coordinates: 35.0035943, 135.7731545
- Languages: Japanese, English (translation tools for other languages)
- Payment: cash, credit cards, QR code payments (transit IC cards not accepted)

## Hand weaving experience

Choose from around 30 yarn colours and weave on a real table loom. Indoor, no experience needed, ages 6+ (children of elementary-school age and under accompanied by an adult), nothing to bring, solo guests welcome. Finished pieces go home the same day. Up to 4 participants per session across all courses (4 looms). Different courses can run in the same session. Groups of 5+ are split across sessions. Non-weaving companions: up to 1 per 2 participants, max 6 people per group.

| Course | Duration | Price (tax incl.) | Start times |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bookmark（しおり） | approx. 30 min | ¥3,300 | 10:00, 12:00, 14:00, 16:00, 18:00 |
| Omamori charm（お守り） | approx. 60 min | ¥5,500 | 10:00, 12:00, 14:00, 16:00, 18:00 |
| Sacoche bag（サコッシュ） | approx. 120 min | ¥13,200 | 10:00, 13:00, 16:00 |

- Booking: Jalan (JP) https://www.jalan.net/kankou/spt_guide000000231178/ · Viator https://www.viator.com/tours/Kyoto/Kyoto-Mindful-Weaving-and-Omamori-Crafting/d332-352022P283 · Klook https://www.klook.com/en-US/activity/220330-blankedkyoto-hand-weaving-experience/
- Walk-ins accepted when space is available; advance booking recommended
- Arrive 5 minutes before start time
- Cancellation: free until 20:00 the day before (all platforms); afterwards the platform's policy applies
- Gift / third-party bookings accepted

## Products

Multi-layer gauze handkerchiefs, face towels, gauze blankets and Kyoto-shop-exclusive items, woven and sewn by Nakamori at its own factory in Gamagori, Aichi. No reservation needed to shop. Online store (Japanese): https://blanked-gauze.com/
